desc.zh: 保留跨块匹配的位置，用重复状态跳过整段扫描。
desc.en: Carry matching progress across blocks and skip cycles of repeated states.

complexity: O(|s1| min(n1, |s2|)) time; O(min(n1, |s2|)) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Boundary-state cycle skipping
concepts.description: Equal next-needed character indices repeat the same block gains.

concepts.name: Greedy repeated subsequence matching
concepts.description: Carry unfinished target progress across source blocks.
